description: This file provides a lightweight client wrapper for interacting with OpenAI's API, specifically for chat completions, and includes a simple AI move suggestion for a Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: chatWithOpenAI({ messages, model = "gpt-4o-mini", signal })
methods.description: Sends a chat message to OpenAI's API or a proxy endpoint if the API key is unavailable. Supports abort signals.

methods.name: suggestNextMove(board, player = "X")
methods.description: Provides a heuristic suggestion for the next move in a Tic-Tac-Toe game based on the current board state.

ctags.name: chatWithOpenAI
ctags.pattern: /^export async function chatWithOpenAI({ messages, model = "gpt-4o-mini", signal }) {$/
